evidence.text: "Scott will tirelessly defend Wisconsin values like the right to life and the Second Amendment."
Rated 100% by National Right to Life Committee

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: Rated 91% by The Club for Growth

"In POTUS’ 1st 100 days he managed to kill #Keystone, crushing countless good paying jobs in #WI05. He doubled down by burdening taxpayers with trillions of dollars of deficit spending. This is bad leadership, "cut jobs, raise taxes," shouldn’t serve as the guiding principle."

"In President Biden’s address tonight, I hope he lays out a vision to build a strong economy with lower taxes, restore faith in our government, and address the historic border crisis. This is what Americans want to hear."
"Today the Senate passed a tax cut package that: Cuts income taxes by $250 million. We’re giving money back to hard-working Wisconsin taxpayers"
